text: Agenda & Things to Discuss… Our quick meeting will examine Urban Wildlife, Barns, 12ers; but Edens2 will dominate the discussion. Whatever Edens we ultimately come up with, they should all intrigue and inspire. Since this is an hour-long Festival program, it has its own set of expectations and demands, and that’s just the way it is, I’m afraid. Here’s where I think we are with Edens2 (I’m guessing this will change a bit after today.) When I try to imagine Edens2 as an hour pledge show, I really think we need to include – if only for all the new people in the state -- some of the special places that we ourselves find hackneyed and over-used. We don’t need to spend much time on them – perhaps in the Tease or Setup or Conclusion, but it seems that somewhere in the show, we should at least see most of what are considered ‘special.’ Perhaps we have all the video we need already; perhaps we still need Drone footage, since we hope to emphasize drone footage. As a point of reference, Planetware lists these as the 9 top rated tourist attractions, in order… Sun Valley, Craters of the Moon, Sawtooths, Lake C’d Alene, Hells Canyon, Shoshone Falls, Boise River Greenbelt, City of Rocks, Old penitentiary The Traveling Spud lists these as the 12 Best Places to Visit in Idaho, in order… McCall, Sun Valley, Coeur d’Alene, Shoshone Falls, Bruneau Sand Dunes, Craters of the Moon, Thousand Springs, Sandpoint, Palouse, Boise, Sawtooth Mountains, Hells Canyon Currently, this is the First Tier group of our Edens… The Bruneau River… Jay & Lauren ALREADY SHOT Curlew National Grassland… Jay & Kris.
